title: ecb / rate decision / euro area | Rate Decision | Monetary policy decisions - European Central Bank
summary: The ECB Governing Council held rates unchanged on 30 April 2026, keeping the deposit facility at 2.00%, main refinancing rate at 2.15%, and marginal lending rate at 2.40%, while flagging that both upside inflation risks and downside growth risks have intensified. The Council attributed the deterioration in the inflation outlook primarily to the Middle East war driving a sharp energy price increase, though longer-term inflation expectations remain anchored.
